mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% triggers an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates on equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses below 4.5% but 20-day returns are not positive, or the rate remains below 4.5% without sustained returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (PAYEMS) signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The correlation between GDPC1 and PAYEMS does not strongly predict positive returns (Rank IC < 0.05), or returns are not significantly higher than baseline in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates (UNRATE < 3%) during a labor market recovery phase indicate strengthening labor demand, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 3% in the recovery regime, or returns are not positive when it does.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in consumer demand (GDPC1) and supply chain activity (INDPRO) signal robust economic growth, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and INDPRO does not correlate with higher returns over 60 days (Rank IC < 0.05), or returns are not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in job openings (PAYEMS > 160,000) indicates strong labor market expansion, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS exceeds 160,000 but 5-day returns are not positive, or the spike is temporary without sustained effects.

mechanism_narrative: A cooling inflation trend (CPIAUCSL < 305) during a monetary tightening cycle suggests reduced policy pressure, easing discount rates on equities and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not stay below 305 in the tightening cycle, or returns are not positive when it does.

mechanism_narrative: Expansion in supply chains (INDPRO) combined with monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) lowers discount rates on equities, boosting valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between INDPRO and FEDFUNDS does not correlate with higher returns over 60 days (Rank IC < 0.05), or returns are not significantly positive.
